description.value: Upper Bench Winery and Creamery is a 9.5-acre estate winery on the Naramata Bench sub-GI in the South Okanagan, known for award-winning bold reds, crisp dry whites, and handcrafted artisanal cheeses made on-site from pasteurized cow's milk. The property features a private patio for guided wine-and-cheese tasting experiences and a wood-fired oven wine bar called The Oven. The Naramata Bench is one of BC's premier cycling routes, making this a natural destination stop for touring cyclists exploring the region.
